proof_body:
by
  intro p _ F a h0 h1
  have hl : ‖Polynomial.aeval a F‖ < ‖Polynomial.aeval a (Polynomial.derivative F)‖ ^ 2 := by
    simpa [Polynomial.coe_aeval_eq_eval, h1] using h0
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hd, _, hu⟩ := hensels_lemma hl
  have h1' : ‖Polynomial.aeval a (Polynomial.derivative F)‖ = 1 := by simpa [Polynomial.coe_aeval_eq_eval] using h1
  rw [h1'] at hd hu
  refine ⟨z, ⟨by simpa [Polynomial.coe_aeval_eq_eval] using hz, hd⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro w ⟨hw, hwa⟩
  exact hu w (by simpa [Polynomial.coe_aeval_eq_eval] using hw) hwa
target_source: ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (F : Polynomial (PadicInt p)) (a : PadicInt p), ‖Polynomial.eval a F‖ < 1 → ‖Polynomial.eval a (Polynomial.derivative F)‖ = 1 → ∃! z : PadicInt p, Polynomial.eval z F = 0 ∧ ‖z - a‖ < 1
